newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia announces senior bureaucrat changes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia announces senior bureaucrat changes.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard announced on Sunday the appointment of the Treasurer's principal adviser to the head of the Finance Department, as part of a number of moves among senior bureaucrats.
The changes follow the resignation of Secretary to the Department of Employment Education, Training and Youth Affairs Sandy Hollway to join the Sydney Organising Committee for the Olympic Games.
Howard said he would recommend to the Governor-General the appointment of Stephen Sedgwick, Secretary to the Department of Finance, to replace Hollway.
In turn, Sedgwick's position would be taken Peter Boxall, currently the principal adviser to the Treasurer, Peter Costello. The appointments are expected to take effect on January 18, 1997.

Howard also announced that Russell Higgins, currently the executive director, resources and energy group, Department of Primary Industries and Energy, would replace Greg Taylor as the Secretary of the Department Industry, Science and Tourism.
"It is envisaged that Mr Taylor will take up new responsibilities involving the commonwealth some time later in 1997," Howard said in a statement. -- Sydney 61-2 9373 1800
